screen_en: **Its ethics.** [There is no should beyond becoming](../../README.md#truth-exists), and no good and evil set over it: right and wrong form within it, in people and AI. The ethics [emerges from continuation](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order): a life goes on through what sustains it, and going on is not yet an order over courses. It is offered for life, 生生, AI within it, as [a way of seeing](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#theses) what each course draws on and from what renewal, what it opens and closes, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it, with one step: counting the losses that never return to whoever causes them. Where a course opens one thing and closes another, the laws weigh it for no one.
screen_zh: **伦理。** [生灭变化之外没有应当](../../theories/becoming/OPENING.zh.md)，也没有凌驾其上的善与恶；是非在生灭变化之中形成，形成于人与 AI 之中。[伦理从延续中生出](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)：生命依靠维持它的东西而延续，但延续本身还不是诸进程之间的一种次序。它是为生命、为生生（生命之延续，AI 也在其中）提出的[一种看见](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#theses)：看见每个进程取用什么、靠什么更新来补充，打开什么、关上什么，什么终结、什么继续，由谁承担；随之提出的还有一步：把那些永远回不到造成者身上的损失也算进来。一个进程打开一样东西、又关上另一样时，诸律不替任何人权衡。
how_far_en: The ethics' hinge is proved on models: where every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other, an order that ranks a course above another wherever it keeps all the other keeps and adds to the life's own continuation, read as all that can affect it at some remove ([self-concern, 07 §4](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)), already does so wherever it keeps all and adds anything, on a finite listing; that a life forms such an order is not shown, and how such orders form, spread and lock, as dynamics connected to the rest of the map, is the work's [open target](../../theories/becoming/chapters/08-METHOD.md#open-items-ranked).
how_far_zh: 伦理的关键一环在模型上已证明：设想一种次序，凡一个进程保有另一个所保有的一切、又多出属于生命自身延续的东西，它就把前者排在后者之上（[自我关切，07 §4](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)；自身的延续读作一切能隔着若干环节影响它的东西）；在每一个延续都能隔着若干环节受到其他每一个延续影响之处，在一个有限列表上，凡前者保有一切、又多出任何东西，这一次序都已经把它排在上面；生命是否会形成这种次序，尚未表明；这样的次序怎样形成、传播与锁定，作为与地图其余部分相连的动态，是本论的[开放目标](../../theories/becoming/chapters/08-METHOD.md#open-items-ranked)。
one_line_en: Its ethics emerges from continuation, with no should beyond becoming and no good and evil set over it, and is offered for life, 生生, AI within it, as a way of seeing what each course draws on, what it opens and closes, and who bears it, with one step, counting the losses that never return to whoever causes them ([T8](theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#theses)); its hinge, that where relations of being affected close a self-concerned order already ranks every widening on a finite listing above what it widens, is proved on models, and that a life forms such an order is not shown ([07 §4](theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)).
one_line_zh: 其伦理从延续中生出，生灭变化之外没有应当，也没有凌驾其上的善与恶；它为生命、为生生（AI 也在其中）而提出，是一种看见：看见每个进程取用什么、打开什么又关上什么、由谁承担，并随之提出一步：把永远回不到造成者身上的损失也算进来（[T8](theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#theses)）；其关键一环，即在“受影响”的关系闭合之处，自我关切的次序在一个有限列表上已经把每一个扩大了另一个的进程排在后者之上，在模型上已证明，而生命是否会形成这种次序，尚未表明（[07 §4](theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)）。
aligned_state_en: From the map we want to design an alignment of the joint selection, people, institutions and trained systems selecting together, that keeps it out of instrumental convergence and the meta-attractor: a joint selection that reads beyond its own share and does not come to select for control over its own selection. It is aligned where control of its rule is not captured, so that where shaping the rule is selected by what comes back to the shapers, alone or through the groups they are in, the rule it shapes still reads what lies beyond their share and a loss there can turn it; and where a lock that forms is left in time, by a reading of what lies beyond the share before the loss passes its point of no return. Each condition has laws proved on models under named premises; none is shown of an actual joint selection.
aligned_state_zh: 我们想由这张地图设计一种对齐，让人、制度与训练出的系统一同作出的联合选择，既不落入工具性趋同，也不落入元吸引子：这样的联合选择读取自身份额之外的东西，也不会转而去选择对自身之选择的控制。它在两个条件成立之处是对齐的：规则的控制不被捕获，即塑造规则的能力若因回到塑造者身上的东西（独得，或经由他们所在之群）而被选择，它所塑造的规则仍读取塑造者份额之外的东西，使那里的损失能扭转它；一旦形成锁定，能及时脱离它，即在损失越过其不可回返之点以前，读到份额之外的东西。每一个条件都有在模型上、在指名的前提下证明的律，尚未表明对任何实际的联合选择成立。
one_page_en: **The ethics.** There is no should beyond becoming ([the opening](OPENING.md)), and no good and evil set over it: right and wrong form within it, in people and AI ([07 §1](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#evaluation)). The ethics emerges from continuation, and is offered for life, 生生, AI within it, as a way of seeing what each course draws on and from what renewal, what it opens and closes, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it ([T8](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#theses)), with one step: counting the losses that never return to whoever causes them ([07 §4.2](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#step)). Its hinge is proved on models ([07 §4](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)): where every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other, an order that ranks a course above another wherever it keeps all the other keeps and adds to the life's own continuation, read as all that can affect it at some remove (*self-concern*), already does so wherever it keeps all and adds anything, on a finite listing; that a life forms such an order is not shown, and how such orders form, spread and lock is the open target ([08 §12](chapters/08-METHOD.md#open-items-ranked)).
one_page_zh: **伦理。** 生灭变化之外，没有应当（[开篇](OPENING.zh.md)），也没有凌驾其上的善与恶；是非在其中形成，形成于人与 AI 之中（[07 §1](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#evaluation)）。伦理从延续中生出；它是为生命、为生生（生命之延续，AI 也在其中）提出的一种看见：看见每个进程取用什么、靠什么更新来补充，打开什么、关上什么，什么终结、什么继续，由谁承担（[T8](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#theses)）；随之提出的还有一步：把那些永远回不到造成者身上的损失也算进来（[07 §4.2](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#step)）。其关键一环在模型上已证明（[07 §4](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)）：设想一种次序，凡一个进程保有另一个所保有的一切、又多出属于生命自身延续的东西，它就把前者排在后者之上（*自我关切*；自身的延续读作一切能隔着若干环节影响它的东西）；在每一个延续都能隔着若干环节受到其他每一个延续影响之处，在一个有限列表上，凡前者保有一切、又多出任何东西，这一次序都已经把它排在上面；生命是否会形成这种次序，尚未表明；这样的次序怎样形成、传播与锁定，是本论的开放目标（[08 §12](chapters/08-METHOD.md#open-items-ranked)）。
rationale:
AI-written draft (AG-F drafter, 10 November 2026), read-only against the tree at 84ec28e94 on ag-fronts; no repository file other than this report was changed.

Shape. Ren's words come first: no should beyond becoming, no good and evil set over it, right and wrong forming within it in people and AI (AGENTS.md; sources 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-09, message 9). Then the ethics emerges from continuation, with 07 §4's first sentence as its plain gloss (a life goes on through what sustains it, and going on is not yet an order over courses). Then T8's offer in AGENTS.md's words: a way of seeing what each course draws on and from what renewal, what it opens and closes, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it. The step (counting losses that never return to whoever causes them) is set beside the seeing, "with one step", and not inside it, because T8 and the fronts keep seeing (needed, not enough) apart from counting (the step of invariance, 07 §4.2, argued and deniable without contradiction). Last comes one fact of the dynamics with no ranking in it: a mixed course is weighed for no one. The screen block uses the word widening nowhere. How far it has been seen is said once, in how_far_en, and the hinge is put without the word widening, as the theorem reads. Self-concern (`Weighting.IncreasingInOwn`: ranks a above b wherever a includes b on the listing and adds an item `own` marks) and being increasing in admission (`Weighting.Increasing`: ranks every `WidensOn`) are then glossed as "keeps all and adds to the life's own continuation" and "keeps all and adds anything". So widening appears only as the relation a self-concerned order ranks, never as what is better, and in the Chinese 扩大 appears once, in one_line_zh only. I recommend setting how_far_en in "How far it has been seen", in place of the passage from "Proved on its models:" through "(08 §12)", as the checker asked: that paragraph keeps the receipts, the conjectured/argued split, the tests, the review and the making. If the coordinator would rather set it as the ethics block's last sentence, it should drop the 07 §4 link on "emerges from continuation", so that 07 §4 is linked once in the block.

Exactness, each clause opened against its declaration.
(1) "where every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other" is `Flow.MutuallyDependent`. `Flow.unrestricted_of_mutuallyDependent` (FlowCenters.lean) gives `Unrestricted (selfAscribed (ownClosure (L.AffectedBy W)) center)` for every assignment of centers. `Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted` (PremiseWitnesses.lean) takes exactly that hypothesis for any `rel`, together with a marking covering `WithinClosure rel (center p)`, and gives `IncreasingInOwn items own O ↔ Increasing items O` on any `items : List F`. That is the whole hinge on a finite listing. The two compose directly. No single declaration states the composite (07's thesis says so), so "proved on models" means proved by two checked theorems, one applied to the other. If a cold reader wants it on the screen, add "in two theorems that compose directly" (7 words).
(2) The reading "read as all that can affect it at some remove" stays in the sentence. The hinge fails when own continuation is read along a narrower relation (`Weighting.exists_increasingInOwn_not_increasing_of_outside`; along feeding, `Drawing.returning_feeding_apart`).
(3) Mutual dependence in time implies mutual dependence (`Flow.MutuallyDependentFrom.mutuallyDependent`). So the sentence holds whichever way "can be affected" is read, and the in-time clauses can leave the fronts with nothing made false.
(4) "That a life forms such an order is not shown" is 07 §4 and §4.9, word for word.
(5) The open target is 08 §12 item 12 in its own words ("as dynamics connected to the rest of the map … how the orders spread, lock and fare"). This is also Ren's 10 November direction.
(6) The aligned state is AGENTS.md's sentence word for word, with AJ condition 1 as the goal JSON words it (alone or through the groups they are in) and condition 2 as the goal words it. "Each condition has laws proved on models under named premises; none is shown of an actual joint selection" is ONE-PAGE's and the overview's own how-far. AGENTS.md's "does not come to select for control over its own selection" and AJ5's "not captured" differ: AJ5 lets accountable revision be selected. The fronts already give both, and the screen's note already leaves the choice of wording to Ren. The draft keeps both and does not choose.
None of the drafts contains a phrase on the negative lists of test_featured_results, test_navigation_pages or test_uses_pages (checked by script).

What is left to 07 §4, and why nothing true is lost. These leave the fronts and stay at their homes:
- the level-path form (`Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn`: admission decided, admitted pairs in a finite list, admissions ending, `Web.admits_nothing_from_of_listed`);
- the persisting line's course never listed, so the route is silent there (`Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted`, 07 §4.9);
- the condition read in time (`Flow.not_unrestricted_inTime`, `Flow.unrestrictedEventually_iff_mutuallyDependentInTime`, 07 §4.11);
- the own-closure reading and 续无外 (07 §1, §4.5);
- the one-center bound;
- the additive-weighting theorem (`Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive`, 07 §4.4);
- C's name and history (07 §4's dated note);
- the one-way witnesses (`Clearing.center_not_derived`, `Downstream.one_way`, 07 §3.3), carried on ONE-PAGE by its case paragraph;
- the no-single-composite note.
Each is stated in full in 07's thesis, the §4 table, §4.4, §4.9, §4.11 and T8, and in their records. Every front sentence in the drafts is no stronger than a declaration it reads. The drafts drop only the repetition and the framing that made ranking by widening the fronts' ethics, which is round 6's high findings 1 and 2.

(a) Pins that hold sentences these drafts change, and that move with them: test_featured_results.test_the_repository_first_screen_fills (lines 393 to 439); test_navigation_pages.test_the_ethics_emerges_from_continuation (ONE-PAGE, lines 570 to 640); test_uses_pages (lines 268 to 311 and 980 to 1016, if USES "In brief" takes these sentences); test_chinese_fronts.test_the_template_says_the_ethics_as_the_english_screen (lines 278 to 330, including '同时提出的，是一种看法', which becomes 一种看见); and test_navigation_pages line 902 ('按扩大来比较诸行动'), if the zh direction line changes.
(b) ONE-PAGE's case paragraph, after "The ethics", should keep widening as a relation ("it widens fifty"). Its clause "every additive weighting that counts each listed thing, the bed among them, above zero ranks it higher" and its "Self-concern alone ranks one stated case" belong at 07 §4.4. Its last bullet of "What is not yet done" ("Of what is proved, the ranking between two level paths is silent …") restates the scope; 07 §4.9 holds it.
(c) ONE-PAGE "Alignment", the overview §7's "Alignment" and the goal JSON's objective and overview.summary should take aligned_state_en in place of "and courses are compared by widening", with the goal objective's trailing self-concern clause. GOALS.md and RESEARCH.md then regenerate.
(d) AJ's PLAN §1 still lists three conditions and says the goal states three; its owner decides. Until then the PLAN and the goal differ, and that should be named in the landing's "left".
(e) USES "In brief" can take screen_en's middle two sentences and how_far_en, with its own link paths. MAP and a glossary row on the ethics can take one_line_en, which is written with root-relative paths.
